use_case: Generative AI engineering assistant inside the government-community collaboration suite: search, summarize, and draft text from CUI engineering documents (specifications, change requests, test reports, work instruction drafts)
business_owner: Aircraft Parts VP of engineering (with the Engineering Services VP of engineering)
vendor_or_model: Collaboration suite provider's integrated large language model add-on (government-community offering)
data_categories: CUI: controlled technical information; ITAR and EAR technical data in prompts, retrieved files, and outputs
consequential_decision_category: None directly; Safety/CI if outputs were used for dimensions, tolerances, NC programs, inspection criteria, or export classifications (prohibited)
human_in_the_loop: A qualified engineer reviews every output; engineering release still needs checker sign-off; numbers are copied from the source document, never from AI output
applicable_laws: DFARS 252.204-7012(b)(2)(ii)(D) (assistant must sit inside the provider's FedRAMP-authorized boundary and CRM); 32 CFR 170.19(c) (CUI Asset in the SSP); ITAR 22 CFR 120.56 and 120.54(a)(5); EAR 15 CFR 734.18(a)(5); FTC Act Sec. 5 (vendor claims)
status: Pilot with conditions (300 users in Aircraft Parts and Engineering Services); expansion paused

use_case: Public generative AI chatbots used by engineers to summarize or rewrite CUI text
data_categories: CUI text pasted by engineers at two Engineering Services centers (found 2026-07)
applicable_laws: DFARS 252.204-7012(a), (c) (possible compromise; reporting decision); ITAR 22 CFR 120.56 and 127.12; EAR 15 CFR 764.5
status: Prohibited with CUI (POL-05 4.8); blocked on all CUI endpoints by 2026-11-30

use_case: Predictive maintenance model that scores component removal risk in both editions of the sustainment analytics platform
vendor_or_model: In-house model trained on platform data
data_categories: Aircraft maintenance and reliability records (Government data in the DoD edition; CUI and commercial data in the industry edition)
affects_individuals: Indirectly (aircrew and passengers through maintenance decisions)
human_in_the_loop: Maintainers and engineers decide; a score never grounds or releases an aircraft by itself
applicable_laws: DFARS 252.239-7010(c)(2) (Government-related data use); DoD edition contract terms; DFARS 252.204-7012(b)(2)(ii)(D) for CUI tenants; FTC Act Sec. 5 (accuracy claims); tenant agreements
status: In production; retraining without DoD edition data due 2026-11-15 (POAM-016); independent validation due 2027-03-31 (POAM-026)

use_case: AI visual inspection assist that flags surface defects on machined and additive parts for inspectors
data_categories: Part images; inspection results (CUI where images show controlled geometry)
human_in_the_loop: Certified inspector accepts or rejects every part; the tool only adds flags and never passes a part
applicable_laws: Prime and DoD quality clauses (contractual); AS9100 quality system; 32 CFR 170.19(c) (Specialized or CUI Asset treatment); ITAR 22 CFR 120.56 (vendor remote support)
status: Proposed; pilot at plant 2 not yet approved

use_case: Generative design and topology optimization tool proposing lighter bracket and fitting geometry
vendor_or_model: CAD vendor generative design module (runs in the GCEE)
data_categories: CUI design constraints and resulting geometry (export-controlled technical data)
human_in_the_loop: Engineers verify every design with standard stress analysis and checker sign-off before release
applicable_laws: DFARS 252.204-7012 (CUI stays in the GCEE); ITAR 22 CFR 120.56 (generated designs are technical data); customer design approval terms

use_case: Coding assistant for platform developers, hosted inside the government-community boundary
vendor_or_model: Coding assistant service in the government-community offering
data_categories: Source code, some export-controlled; no customer data by policy
human_in_the_loop: Developers review all suggestions; normal code review and pipeline tests apply
applicable_laws: ITAR 22 CFR 120.56 and EAR 15 CFR 734.13(a)(2) (export-controlled source code stays with U.S. persons in approved systems); POL-05 4.7 and 4.8
status: Approved; public assistants to be blocked on developer laptops by 2026-12-31

use_case: Resume screening and ranking tool for engineering hiring
human_in_the_loop: Recruiters review every candidate the tool ranks low before rejection; no automatic rejection
applicable_laws: Title VII (disparate impact; 29 CFR 1607.4(D) four-fifths guideline); state and local AI employment laws in each state where candidates are located (examples: Colorado SB26-189 from 2027-01-01, status unsettled; Illinois HB 3773; NYC Local Law 144 for NYC roles; California ADS regulations)
status: Proposed; not approved until a bias audit and state-law review are complete

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant in the commercial productivity tenant for non-CUI work
data_categories: Internal and confidential non-CUI business data only
human_in_the_loop: Users review outputs; CUI is blocked by data loss rules
applicable_laws: POL-04 4.10; POL-05 4.7 and 4.8; FTC Act Sec. 5 (vendor claims)

use_case: Supplier cybersecurity risk scoring to prioritize CMMC and SPRS verification
data_categories: Supplier names, public security signals, SPRS and CMMC status entered by staff
human_in_the_loop: Supplier quality engineers decide; a score never approves or rejects a supplier by itself
applicable_laws: DFARS 252.204-7020(g)(2) and 252.204-7021(f)(2) remain human checks; contract terms with the scoring vendor
